name: Pact of the Tome
description: Conjure a Book of Shadows at the end of a Short or Long Rest. While carrying it, gain three extra cantrips from any class list and two level-1 Ritual spells, with the book as a focus. For this alpha, starter Ritual spells are ritual-only unless separately known; replacement does not recharge limited uses. Book of Ancient Secrets separately supports additional rituals.
deepenedAtLevel5: Cast each of Animate Dead, Haste, and Call Lightning once separately without a slot per Long Rest; ordinary casting requirements and concentration apply. The book does not refresh the three uses when replaced.
